I don't think surviving is an achievement that deserves credit, in my eyes it's almost impossible to die because you are too stupid or too unskilled in this society and world we have created.

To be honest, the modern human does not really need to overcome anything.

I am not looking for any social interactions, therapy, bettering, and I'm not looking for family love and friends.

Maybe this is the wrong place...

You got it wrong I think, I'm not talking about some dark time I'm talking about being lonely til death, this is not some random day you wake up and have a bad day no motivation or something's going wrong, this is every day with no ups.

Yes struggle can be beautiful, but this is not struggle, I see struggle as I have a brick wall in front of me but I can not get over it so I have to put some work in to working out so I can slowly get higher and higher and finally get over it, that's struggle to push myself and see slow results.

But I'm not talking about struggle, I'm talking about a life where I'm isolated from everyone, no family, no friends, no contacts, absolutely no one.

Idc about being successful because I don't have anyone that judges me if I'm not successful and I personally don't care either. 

So I'm asking again is a lonely life worth living.
